cases.golden_answer: The L^p norm is ||x||_p = (sum_i |x_i|^p)^{1/p} for p >= 1. A norm maps vectors to non-negative values, is zero only for the zero vector, satisfies the triangle inequality, and obeys f(alpha x) = |alpha| f(x).
